name: verify-image-signature-v1
description: Verifies the signature of each image with given public keys or trusted keyless identities
remediation: Replace the image with an image that is signed correctly

controlConfigInputs.name: Trusted Cosign public keys
controlConfigInputs.description: A list of trusted Cosign public keys that are used for validating container image signatures.

controlConfigInputs.name: Require Cosign transparency log entry
controlConfigInputs.description: Whether a valid signature must also have a transparency log (Rekor) entry. Set to false to accept images signed with --tlog-upload=false, such as in private registries and air-gapped clusters; the key and signed image digest are still verified. Any other value, or no value, keeps the entry required.

controlConfigInputs.name: Cosign Rekor URL
controlConfigInputs.description: URL of the Rekor transparency log used to look up signatures that have no Rekor bundle, like cosign verify --rekor-url. Leave empty to keep the default behaviour. Ignored when cosignRequireTransparencyLog is false.

controlConfigInputs.name: Trusted Cosign keyless identities
controlConfigInputs.description: Keyless (Fulcio) signers to trust. Each entry is an OIDC issuer regular expression, whitespace, then a certificate identity regular expression, like cosign verify --certificate-oidc-issuer-regexp --certificate-identity-regexp. For example: ^https://token\.actions\.githubusercontent\.com$ ^https://github\.com/my-org/. The issuer ends at the first whitespace. The expressions are not anchored, so add ^ and $ yourself. An image passes if either a trusted public key or a trusted identity verifies it.
